# supabase/tests/fixtures/partner_owner_privileges.txt
#
# A checked-in fixture of EXACTLY the privileges the five partner owner roles (supabase/migrations/0047_partner_auth_spine.sql) may hold: partner_session_toucher, _issuer and
# partner_pin_verifier, _totp_verifier, _reauth_verifier. It is the twin of private.partner_owner_privilege, the same way definer_policy_exprs.txt is the twin of
# private.definer_policy_allowlist: tools/db/verify-function-inventory.mjs check 12 re-derives the real privileges from the catalog and compares them with the TABLE, and compares the table
# with THIS FILE, so widening a role's privilege together with its registry row (self-consistent for the catalog check) still shows as a diff in review. Regenerate it, and review the
# diff by hand, whenever a migration changes what one of these roles holds. The comparison lives in the node check: a pgTAP file cannot read a file.
#
# Format: one JSON object per line (JSONL): {role_name, object_kind (schema | relation | column | function), object_name, privilege, column_name (columns only, else null)},
# ordered by (role_name, object_kind, object_name, privilege, column_name). Lines starting with '#' are comments, skipped by the reader.
#
# Regenerate from a freshly-migrated database:
#   psql -At -c "SELECT jsonb_build_object('role_name',role_name,'object_kind',object_kind,'object_name',object_name,'privilege',privilege,'column_name',column_name)::text
#     FROM private.partner_owner_privilege ORDER BY role_name,object_kind,object_name,privilege,column_name;"
# 0052 (S1.3): partner_pin_verifier gains the PIN table (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE; no DELETE), SELECT of the two session columns a PIN set must see (enrolment_until, otp_proof_until) and EXECUTE of the
# policy predicate partner_binding_user() and the pepper core partner_pin_core(). Regenerated from a freshly migrated database; the diff is review material.
